content: Mǝ nda rǝ ɓakɓabum aɓwana-mǝgule mǝnana aɓalǝ wun ngga kǝla ɓi'wun ɓwamǝgule. Ən sǝn nutanni mala Kǝrǝsti nǝ amǝsǝam, sǝ mim gbal ka, mǝ nǝ kum kāmbe mem aɓa ɓoarɓwa male, yi mǝnana ɓǝ̀ yi pusǝna rǝì aban ɓanza ka.

Wu yál domwan mala Ɓakuli mǝnana tsǝk wun a yalè ka. Wu tsǝk mǝsǝ wun arǝì nǝ eare ma'wun, kǝla mǝnana Ɓakuli earce ka, pà kǝla à tsǝk wun púp ɗang. Wu pak turè sǝ wu kǝa tsǝk ɓalǝ wun arǝ gir mǝnana wun nǝ̀ kùmô aɓalǝi ka ɗàng, wu pè acemǝnana wu ndanǝ rǝɓǝla mala pakki Ɓakuli túró ka.
Aɓwana mǝnana à tsǝk wun amúrià ama wu ɗenyi nǝia ka, wu kǝa lǝmdǝia wia rǝcandǝa ɗàng, wu duk girkànì a bania.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ Gbani mala ayálgír yi pusǝna rǝì ka, wun nǝ̀ kum mbulan-gulo mǝɓoarne mǝnana pà nǝ̀ è raka.
Sǝ wun alo-ɓwa gbal ka, wu kǝ nongsǝ mur wun aɓata aɓwana-mǝgule. Wun kat ka, wu do nǝ nyesǝmuru a rǝarǝ wun, acemǝnana Malǝmce na ama:

content.text: sǝ kǝ lǝmdǝì amǝ nyesǝmúrû ɓwamuru.>>

content: Ace mani ka, wu nyesǝ múr wun aɓata rǝcandǝa mǝgule mala Ɓakuli, sǝ ɓǝ̀ pwari male karǝ ka, nǝ̀ loasǝ wun a kùli.
Gìr mǝnana kat kǝ pisǝ bum wun ngga, wu nyinggi Ɓakuli a buì, acemǝnana yì ka, kǝ ɗenyi nǝ wun.
Wu hami rǝ wun, sǝ wu tsǝkir wun. Ɓi wun mǝbura, yi Mgbǝrǝm ngga, nda rǝ gāliki arǝ aban kǝla im mǝnana nzala kǝ wali ka, aban alta ɓwa mǝnana nǝ̀ bwal ka.
Wu tamsǝ kusǝ wun kàngkàng aɓa paɓamuru ma'wun, wu ɓinǝi wi. Wu sǝlǝ ama aɓi wun amǝkwaɗi aɓa ɓanza kat ka, à nda ban nu ulang tanni ma'wun.

Ɓakuli ka nda mǝtala ɓwamuru kat. Yì nda mana tunǝ wun aɓa gulo male mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka, aɓa Kǝrǝsti Yesu. Anzǝm mǝnana wu nùnà tanni aɓalǝ apwari bǝti ka, yì nǝ nggearǝì nǝ̀ nyesǝ wun a ban came mǝɓoarne, nǝ̀ pà wun gbasha, andǝ rǝcandǝa. Ɗǝm ngga nǝ̀ dumsǝ wun aɓa lidǝmba mana pà wu nǝ̀ dǝurǝ raka.
Rǝcandǝa kat ka, a baní sǝ pa, málá male pà kàm ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ do anggo.

Nǝ́ bu Silas mǝnana ǝn earnǝi kǝla mǝ'eamrǝarǝu mǝ'mǝsǝcau nì ka, sǝ ǝn nggǝ gilǝa wun mǝnia yì cau gbǝlǝm ngga. Ən nggǝ earce mǝ ɓak ɓabum wun, sǝ mǝ na wun ama, mǝnia yì gir wu nda ɓālǝi ado ka, ɓwamuru mala Ɓakuli na kat ace wun. Wu cam kàngkàng aɓalǝi.
, mǝnana Ɓakuli tár wun wunǝia ɓǝ̀ wu duk amale ka, kǝ makka wun kún. Sǝ munem, yì Markus ka, kǝ makka wun kún gbal.
Wu makkia rǝ wun kún nǝ earcearǝu mala amǝkwaɗi. Ɓǝ̀ rǝpwala do atà wun kat, wun aɓwana mǝnana wu nda aɓa Kǝrǝsti ka.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 23:12; Luk 14:11; Luk 18:14.

Babila: Mǝnia ka, lullǝu sǝmbǝrǝa na ace nggea-là Roma.
Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Atúró 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Kol 4:10; Film 24.
